test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, how many IIMs (Indian Institutes of Management) are there?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of October 2020, there are **20** Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) in India.
 
• The IIMs are premier business schools in India, established to provide quality management education and research.
 
• These institutes are autonomous and offer various postgraduate, doctoral, and executive education programs in management.
 
• The IIMs are known for their rigorous admission process, which includes the Common Admission Test (CAT), group discussions, and personal interviews.
 
• They have a significant impact on management education and are highly regarded both in India and globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first IIM was established in **Calcutta** (now Kolkata) in 1961.
 
• The IIMs are governed by the **Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017**, which declares them as institutions of national importance.
 
• The Act provides greater autonomy to the IIMs in their operations, administration, and academic activities.
 
• The IIMs have a strong alumni network, with many graduates holding prominent positions in various industries worldwide.
 
• In addition to their academic programs, the IIMs also engage in consulting, research, and executive education, contributing to the broader business and academic community.
